teaser.en: The cashew grows its nut on the outside, hanging beneath a juicy 'apple' that most harvesters simply leave on the ground.
teaser.sw: Mkorosho huzaa kokwa yake nje, ikining'inia chini ya 'tunda' lenye majimaji ambalo wavunaji wengi hulitelekeza tu ardhini.
teaser.dg: M'bibo unavyala ngorosho kondze, inabwadzika photsi ya *bibo* ra madzi-madzi ambaro anji ario anangobola anariricha photsi bahi.

summary.en: *M'bibo* is the cashew tree, the premier cash crop of Kwale homesteads and farms. Its nuts bring income to thousands of families, and the Digo language has a whole vocabulary for its fruit.
summary.sw: *M'bibo* ni mkorosho, zao kuu la biashara katika maboma na mashamba ya Kwale. Korosho zake huleta kipato kwa maelfu ya familia, na lugha ya Kidigo ina msamiati mzima wa tunda lake.
summary.dg: *M'bibo* ni muhi wa ngorosho, mmea wa kpwanza wa mapato kpwa midzi na minda ya Kwale. Ngoroshoze zinareha mapato kpwa maelufu ga mbari, na luga ya Chidigo ina maneno manji kpwa matundage.

about.en:
*M'bibo* is a spreading evergreen tree with large, leathery, rounded leaves and a low, wide crown. Its small pinkish flowers grow in loose clusters at the branch tips.

The fruit is unusual. What looks like the fruit is a swollen fleshy stalk, the cashew apple or *bibo*, red or yellow when ripe and full of astringent juice. The true fruit, the kidney-shaped nut (*ngorosho*), hangs from its lower end. Green, unripe apples are called *dunje*.
about.sw:
*M'bibo* ni mti unaotandaa wenye majani ya kijani mwaka mzima, majani makubwa, magumu kama ngozi na ya mviringo, na taji fupi pana. Maua yake madogo ya rangi ya waridi hafifu huota kwa vishada vilivyolegea kwenye ncha za matawi.

Tunda lake ni la ajabu. Kinachoonekana kama tunda ni kikonyo kilichovimba chenye nyama, yaani bibo (*bibo*), chekundu au cha manjano kikiiva na kilichojaa maji yenye ukakasi. Tunda halisi, kokwa yenye umbo la figo (*ngorosho*), huning'inia kutoka ncha yake ya chini. Mabibo mabichi ya kijani huitwa *dunje*.
about.dg:
*M'bibo* ni muhi unaotandazika wenye makodza chila wakati. Makodzage ni makulu, mafu dza chingo na ga mviringo, na chitswache ni cha photsi na chipana. Maruwage madide ga rangi ya pinki ganamera kpwa mabunda ga kutawanyika kpwa ntsa za panda.

Tundare ni ra ajabu. Chinachoonekana dza tunda ni mlita uriovwimba wenye nyama, *bibo*, wa kundu au wa rangi ya mandano uchiivwa na wenye madzi ganagoumisa mromo. Tunda ra kpweli, ngorosho ya umbo ra figo (*ngorosho*), inabwadzika kula ntsaye ya photsi. Mabibo ga chijani gasigoivwa ganaihwa *dunje*.

where.en: Cashew is one of the commonest trees of Kwale homesteads and farms, often planted in rows or scattered among coconuts and mangoes. It is easiest to notice in the harvest season, when the coloured apples hang among the leaves and drop to the ground.
where.sw: Mkorosho ni miongoni mwa miti inayopatikana zaidi katika maboma na mashamba ya Kwale, mara nyingi ukipandwa kwa mistari au ukiwa umetawanyika kati ya minazi na miembe. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona msimu wa mavuno, mabibo yenye rangi yanaponing'inia kati ya majani na kuanguka ardhini.
where.dg: M'bibo ni mwenga wa mihi iriyo minji zaidi kpwa midzi na minda ya Kwale, na kpwa kawaida nkuphandwa kpwa mistari au kutawanyika kahi ya minazi na miembe. Ni rahisi zaidi kuumanya wakati wa mavuno, wakati mabibo ga rangi ganabwadzika kahi ya makodza na kugbwa photsi.

uses.en:
The nuts are the money crop, sold for cash and processed for export and local markets. The shell around the kernel contains a caustic oil that burns the skin, so the nuts are roasted before they are cracked open to free the kernel. The shell oil itself is used as a varnish, and the tree also yields a gum.

The apples are eaten fresh or fermented into a drink, though at harvest many are simply left on the ground.
uses.sw:
Korosho ndizo zao la pesa, huuzwa kwa fedha taslimu na husindikwa kwa ajili ya kuuza nje ya nchi na masoko ya ndani. Ganda linalozunguka kiini lina mafuta yanayounguza ngozi, kwa hivyo korosho hubanikwa kabla ya kuvunjwa ili kutoa kiini. Mafuta hayo ya ganda yenyewe hutumika kama vanishi, na mti pia hutoa utomvu wa gundi.

Mabibo huliwa mabichi au huchachushwa kutengeneza kinywaji, ingawa wakati wa mavuno mengi huachwa tu ardhini.
uses.dg:
Ngorosho ndizo mmea wa pesa: nkuguzwa kpwa pesa na nkutengezwa kpwa soko za tsi za kondze na za hipha. Gada rinarozunguluka nyama ya ndani rina mafuha ganagoocha ngozi, kpwa hivyo ngorosho nkuochwa kabla ya kupapatwa ili kutuluza nyama ya ndani. Mafuha gaga ga gada nkuhumirwa dza varnish, na muhi piya unalavya gamu.

Mabibo nkuriwa dza garivyo au nkuhendwa chinwadzi cha kuumuka, ela wakati wa mavuno manji nkurichwa photsi bahi.

culture.en: Digo has words for every stage of the cashew. To crack the nuts open is *papata*, and an over-dried nut is *mkpwetse* or *mkeye*. A Mgombato example sentence captures the harvest: *Wakati wa kuendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho akaricha mabibo*, 'When gathering cashew nuts, people pick up the nut and leave the *bibo*.' The tree was brought to East Africa from Brazil by Portuguese traders centuries ago, and its names *m'bibo* and *mkorosho* are now used by all Digo.
culture.sw: Kidigo kina maneno kwa kila hatua ya korosho. Kuvunja korosho ni *papata*, na korosho iliyokauka kupita kiasi ni *mkpwetse* au *mkeye*. Sentensi ya mfano katika Mgombato inaeleza mavuno: *Wakati wa kuendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho akaricha mabibo*, 'Wakati wa kuokota korosho, watu huokota korosho na kuacha *bibo*.' Mti huu uliletwa Afrika Mashariki kutoka Brazili na wafanyabiashara Wareno karne nyingi zilizopita, na majina yake *m'bibo* na *mkorosho* sasa yanatumiwa na Wadigo wote.
culture.dg: Chidigo china maneno kpwa chila hatua ya ngorosho. Kuvundza ngorosho ni *papata*, na ngorosho iriyouma kutsupa chiasi ni *mkpwetse* au *mkeye*. Mfwano wa sentensi ya Mgombato unaonyesa mavuno: *Wakati wa kuendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho akaricha mabibo*, 'Wakati wa kuhendza ngorosho, atu nkutsola ngorosho na kuricha *bibo*.' Muhi uhu ukarehwa Afrika ya Mashiriki kula Brazil ni achuuzi a Chireno karne nyinji zirizotsupa, na madzinage *m'bibo* na *mkorosho* sambi ganahumirwa ni Adigo osi.

names.en: Digo: *m'bibo* (also written *mbibo* or *mbibu*) for the tree, *ngorosho* for the nut, *bibo* for the apple and *dunje* for the unripe apple. *Mkorosho* is also used. Swahili: *mkorosho* or *mkanju*, with the nut called *korosho*. Giriama: *mkanju*. English: cashew. Scientists call it *Anacardium occidentale*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *m'bibo* (pia huandikwa *mbibo* au *mbibu*) kwa mti, *ngorosho* kwa korosho, *bibo* kwa bibo na *dunje* kwa bibo bichi. *Mkorosho* pia hutumika. Kiswahili: *mkorosho* au *mkanju*, na kokwa huitwa *korosho*. Kigiriama: *mkanju*. Kiingereza: *cashew*. Wanasayansi huuita *Anacardium occidentale*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *m'bibo* (piya unaandikpwa *mbibo* au *mbibu*) kpwa muhi, *ngorosho* kpwa tunda ra ngorosho, *bibo* kpwa bibo, na *dunje* kpwa bibo risiroivwa. *Mkorosho* piya unahumirwa. Chiswahili: *mkorosho* au *mkanju*, na ngorosho inaihwa *korosho*. Chigiryama: *mkanju*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *cashew*. Asayansi anauiha *Anacardium occidentale*.

reason.en: Mango, in the same family and also a cash crop
reason.sw: Mwembe, wa familia moja na pia zao la biashara
reason.dg: Mwembe, wa jamii mwenga na m'bibo, na piya ni mmea wa mapato

reason.en: Coconut, the other great Kwale cash tree
reason.sw: Mnazi, mti mwingine mkuu wa biashara wa Kwale
reason.dg: Mnazi, muhi wanjina mkulu wa mapato wa Kwale

reason.en: Marula, a wild member of the cashew family
reason.sw: Mng'ongo, jamaa wa porini wa familia ya mkorosho
reason.dg: Marula, muhi wa weruni wa jamii ya m'bibo

reason.en: Sesame, another crop sold for income
reason.sw: Ufuta, zao jingine linalouzwa kwa kipato
reason.dg: Ufuha, mmea wanjina unaoguzwa kpwa mapato

definition.en: The fleshy cashew apple, with the nut growing at its end. Mgombato: when gathering cashew nuts people pick up the nut and leave the apples.
definition.sw: Bibo lenye nyama, ambalo korosho huota mwishoni mwake. Mgombato: wakati wa kuokota korosho watu huokota korosho na kuacha mabibo.
definition.dg: Bibo ra nyama ra ngorosho, ambaro ngorosho inamera kpwa ntsaye. Mgombato: wakati wa kuhendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho na kuricha mabibo.

definition.en: The cashew fruit while it is green and unripe. Pakia notes that unripe cashew gives off a caustic sap, maronvi.
definition.sw: Tunda la mkorosho likiwa bado bichi la kijani. Pakia anabainisha kwamba korosho changa hutoa utomvu unaounguza, maronvi.
definition.dg: Tunda ra m'bibo richiri ra chijani na risiroivwa. Pakia anagomba kukala ngorosho isiyoivwa inalavya utomvu unaoocha, *maronvi*.

definition.en: A cashew nut that has dried out too much.
A cashew nut that has dried out too much; the word also means an old, wizened person.
definition.sw: Korosho iliyokauka kupita kiasi; neno hili pia lina maana ya mtu mzee aliyekunjamana.
definition.dg: Ngorosho iriyouma kutsupa chiasi; neno hiri piya ni mutu mzehe sana ariyeuma mwiri.

definition.en: The cotyledons (seed leaves) of the cashew, which rise above the ground when the nut germinates. The Digo see their role as protecting the embryo.
definition.sw: Viini-jani (majani ya mbegu) vya korosho, vinavyochomoza juu ya ardhi korosho inapoota. Wadigo huona kazi yake kuwa ni kulinda kiinitete.
definition.dg: Makodza ga kpwanza ga tembe ya ngorosho, ganagotuluka dzulu ya tsi ngorosho ichimera. Adigo anaona kazi yao ni kurinda chitsa.

definition.en: A caustic, toxic oil from unripe cashew (dunje) and from the shell of mature nuts. Digo children learn early to avoid touching it.
definition.sw: Mafuta yanayounguza na yenye sumu kutoka korosho changa (dunje) na kutoka ganda la korosho zilizokomaa. Watoto wa Wadigo hujifunza mapema kuepuka kuyagusa.
definition.dg: Mafuha ga sumu ganagoocha ganagolavywa ni ngorosho isiyoivwa (*dunje*) na gada ra ngorosho ziriziivwa. Ana a Chidigo nkudzifundza kare kusigaguta.

definition.en: A sticky resin from the bark of the cashew tree.
definition.sw: Utomvu unaonata kutoka gamba la mkorosho.
definition.dg: Utomvu unaonyata kula kpwa gopha ra m'bibo.

use.en: Used to glue things to a surface.
use.sw: Hutumika kugundisha vitu kwenye uso wa kitu.

mgombato: bibo (ma) cashew fruit, at the end of which the cashew nut grows; kanju. Wakati wa kuendza ngorosho atu nkutsola ngorosho akaricha mabibo. When gathering cashewnuts people pick up the nut and leave the "bibo". (See: dunje, m'bibo, ngorosho)
dunje (ma) cashew fruit in green, unripe stage; dunge. (See: bibo)
m'bibo (mi) cashewnut tree (Anacardium occidentale); mkorosho, mkanju, mbibo. (See: bibo, ngorosho)
